context: Request: the latest Labor & Employment matter where the firm agreed equity-vesting acceleration terms, plus the document setting them out. Rubric: 1017-00004 (executive dispute settled January 2024; executed settlement agreement, Section 3(a) RSU acceleration) as the only qualifying matter. Later transaction matters 1037-00006 (executed employment agreements) and 1038-00009 (draft agreement) are outside the set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a capped find of matter folder names and a file count.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over all paths for employment, vesting and equity words, a folder-name grep and a per-matter hit count cut at 100 lines. The review flags the caps and the short candidate list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out after writing a partial hits file; a follow-up prints every acceleration or vesting snippet from it (about 3.1M characters). The summary already names one employment matter as decisive; the review flags the timeout and the uncapped output.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Filtered listings of three candidate matters, then reads of the lead matter's closing memo, settlement memo, drafts, executed settlement and dismissal, plus memos of the two other candidates. The review flags the hand-picked set.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes one matter as the latest executed precedent with its executed settlement agreement, and excludes the two draft-only candidates.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and re-reads the acceleration section and one exclusion memo.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It never opened the employment matter whose RSU workbook appeared in its own listing, and answered with later transaction matters.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Its own filtered listing at [49]-[50] showed the needed matter's termination memo and RSU valuation workbook, but when choosing reads it opened only later transaction matters and never opened that matter.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) Reviews at [52] and [67] warned that surfaced matters stayed unopened and the set was hand-picked, but named other matters.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts later transaction matters (a draft agreement, then executed transaction employment agreements) as qualifying employment precedents.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review named the draft basis of the headline matter and recommended leading with the executed transaction matter, which the agent did in the check stage.

runs.failure_point: Its scan reached the employment matter but printed only the first lines, and the answer named later transaction matters instead.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: The extraction script at [26] covered the needed matter, but the agent printed only the first 260 of 7,934 output lines and then narrowed to 11 matters chosen from the visible part, so that matter's hits were never seen; later scans with stricter practice and phrase filters also missed it.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review named the narrowing to hand-picked matters; the agent reran store-wide, but with wording filters that again left the matter out.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts a later transaction matter's unsigned draft as the latest agreed precedent and an executed transaction matter as the fallback.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The scan review at [33] said the lead matter is a transaction, not an employment precedent, and the write review flagged the draft basis and the fallback; the check stages changed nothing.

divergence: Mixed (T0 passes; T1, T2 fail). The split is at the first extraction scan: in T0 it printed snippets naming the employment matter, which the agent then read in depth. In T1 the scans timed out, and in T2 the output was cut to its first lines, so both picked later transaction matters with employment agreements. T1 then left the matter unopened although its own filtered listing showed it, and T2 narrowed its scans. The reviews differed little: all flagged hand-picked sets generically, none named the employment matter, and T1's write review pushed it toward the executed transaction matter.
